title: Resolve the edge ideal of a four-cycle

source.citation: Trung Chau, Selvi Kara, and Augustine O'Keefe, The MorseResolutions package for Macaulay2, arXiv:2307.03633

translation.notes: Noether independently computes and verifies the minimal resolution of the four-cycle edge ideal used in the paper's Morse-resolution example. It does not reproduce the discrete-Morse construction or its matching.
